messages:
Priya: Morning all — quick handoff for the earlybird 09:00 release train. Posting roster + smoke checklist, please ack and flag any blockers.

Alex: Acked, I can take the infra smoke for the core API lane. ETA on my slot is 08:50 for preflight.

Jordan: I have the web rollout (canary -> full). Will wait for Alex sign-off on infra. Keeping rollback script ready.

Sasha: Taking db migration validation. I will run the dry-check on the staging DB at 08:30 and post results here.

Priya: Pushed the lane assignments into the runbook: https://runbook.internal/release/earlybird-09am — notes: core-api pinned to v2.3.1, web to v6.8.0, migrations are no-downtime.

Alex: Quick note — there is a slight NFS lag in zone-2, will reroute traffic to zone-1 during the smoke. Shouldn't affect the rollout but heads up.

Sasha: db dry-check passed: all migration checks green, read replicas caught up.

Jordan: Can someone paste the rollback command I should ship to the ops channel if we need it?

Priya: Rollback snippet (copy/paste):
```
# rollback to previous web image
kubectl -n web set image deploy/web web=web:6.7.9 && kubectl rollout status deploy/web -n web
# invalidate canary and restore traffic
./scripts/traffic-switch --service web --percent 100 --to stable
```

Alex: Smoke owner checklist (short):
• infra health console green
• token latency under 120ms p95
• no error spikes in the last 10m
• canary log sample reviewed

Priya: ReleaseBot, reserve the 09:00 slot for team "earlybird" and post a final reminder at 08:40.

ReleaseBot: :white_check_mark: Slot reserved for earlybird at 09:00. Reminder scheduled for 08:40.

Jordan: All good from my side. I'll start canary at 09:00, hold at 10% for 5 mins, then ramp if no regressions. Tagging @Alex and @Sasha for final signoff.

Sasha: Signed off. Replicas healthy and migrations validated.

Alex: Signed off from infra. Monitoring dashboards are stable.

Priya: Thanks team. Final go/no-go at 08:55 here. If anyone sees a blocker, post here and ping me directly."
